Bill.BriefDescription: Regulating disposition of returned license plates.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to disposition of returned license plates; andadding a new section to chapter 46.16 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department may, upon request, provide license plates that havebeen used and subsequently returned to the department to individualsfor nonvehicular use. The department shall charge a fee of up to fivedollars per plate to cover costs of recovery, postage, and handling.The department may waive the fee for plates used in educationalprojects, and may, by rule, provide standards for the fee waiver andrestrictions on the number of plates provided to any one person.
